title: DFA rebukes Chinese envoy over ‘thinly veiled threat’ of force; Teodoro says Beijing is ‘intimidating’ PH

blocks.text: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) on Friday rebuked Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan over remarks it said appeared to convey a “thinly veiled threat” of the use of force, as Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. accused Beijing of intimidating Manila amid tensions in the West Philippine Sea.
